title: Tenant compliance traceability reports with smart sampling and scheduled publish
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Deliver a unified, tenant-configurable system that produces residency-tagged compliance reports (PDF and CSV), a lightweight dashboard rollup, and scheduled/triggered delivery to customer sinks with tamper-evident manifests. Focus on traceability (which data was included, retention windows, redaction notes), smart-sampling for large tenants to reduce export size while preserving auditability, and flexible delivery (S3/GCS/FTP/webhook/email). The feature must respect regional residency filters, retention policies, and KMS-encrypted transport for regulated customers.
acceptance_criteria: Per-tenant schedule configuration that supports daily, weekly, monthly, and adhoc runs
Exports can be generated as PDF (templated) and CSV (raw rows) and include a signed manifest with residency, retention cutoff, and sample seed
Smart-sampling option that deterministically includes at least N% of high-risk events and probabilistically samples remaining events while preserving reproducibility
Delivery targets: S3/GCS + signed URL, customer SFTP, and webhook with retry/backoff; each delivery includes end-to-end encryption with customer KMS support
Dashboard tile in Console showing last successful export, size, records included, and delivery status; ability to re-run from UI
Retention enforcement: exported records are selected according to tenant retention policy and redaction flags and documented in manifest
Observability: metrics for export latency, success rate, bytes exported and per-tenant cost estimate
E2E tests and a security review completed prior to release to Dedicated/Private customers
updates: 2026-01-21: Initial scoping meeting — defined goals: traceability, residency routing, smart-sampling, and delivery sinks. Action: PM to draft PRD.

2026-02-03: PRD v0.2 posted to Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/COMPLIANCE/pages/Export+Traceability+PRD. Key open items: sampling algorithm, manifest signing format, and SFTP support details.
2026-02-16: Design sync with Design (Maggie Chen) — agreed on PDF template that highlights residency and retention stamps; design will hand off HTML/CSS templates by 2026-02-25.
2026-02-22: Engineering spike complete (ENG-7821) — prototype Can generate CSV with manifest; KV cache integration to compute retention cutoffs is blocked on ENG-7904 date-window index changes.
2026-02-28: Security flagged KMS integration and suggested a threat model review. Security review request created and scheduled; blocking documentation for Dedicated/Private release until completed.

2026-03-05: Decided sampling strategy: deterministic reservoir sampling seeded by tenant-id + window timestamp. This preserves reproducibility and allows auditors to rehydrate samples given seed and manifest.
2026-03-09: MVP scope locked: PDF + CSV export, one delivery sink (S3/GCS), webhook notification, console dashboard tile, sampling opt-in. SFTP/email deferred to post-MVP.
2026-03-10: Assignee started work on export orchestration service and scheduling UI. Created initial GitHub RFC: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/112
notes: Trade-offs discussed: full exports vs sampled exports for large tenants — sampling reduces cost but requires clear audit metadata. Chosen compromise: default to full export for tenants < 5M rows, enable sampling for larger tenants with policy

Manifest format proposal: JSON lines document with line items describing slices included (time ranges, residency tags, retention cutoff, redaction hashes) and a SHA256 signature using platform signing key; option to include tenant-provided signing certificate for Dedicated/Private
Rollback plan: if delivery fails repeatedly, system creates a support ticket and flags tenant for manual delivery; console allows manual re-run and download
Performance considerations: exports should run in background compute cluster with rate-limited reads to avoid affecting serving SLOs; consider throttling by tenant

Compliance edge case: when a tenant changes retention policy mid-window, exports must record the policy that applied at export-time and include a note in manifest; do not retroactively delete exported records
